mainEntity.name: When should I engage a contractor in the budgeting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engaging a contractor early in the budgeting process, ideally during the design phase, can provide significant benefits. Their expertise helps establish realistic cost estimates, identify potential challenges, and suggest value-engineering options before detailed plans are finalized. This collaborative approach can prevent costly redesigns or scope reductions later on. Hometelligent Inc. works with clients from the conceptual stage to ensure the project vision aligns with a feasible budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a contractor early, during the design phase, to get realistic cost estimates, identify challenges, and suggest value-engineering options. This prevents costly redesigns and aligns the project vision with the budget.
